features.featureTitle: Fix the Tailwind theme token values so the app’s default text color actually applies as green across the UI (all normal text that uses `text-foreground` / inherits from `body`). Update `frontend/src/index.css` CSS variables to match the format expected by `frontend/tailwind.config.js` (i.e., variables should be raw OKLCH components like `0.88 0.28 145`, not `oklch(...)`, because Tailwind already wraps them with `oklch(var(--...))`). Ensure both `:root` and `.dark` define `--foreground` (and related `*-foreground` variables used for typical text) as green so the user-visible text changes are clearly visible.

Audit and update any non-immutable UI components that hardcode text colors (e.g., `text-black`, `text-white`, or other non-token colors) so that user-facing text follows the theme tokens (prefer `text-foreground`, `text-muted-foreground`, `text-primary`, etc.) and therefore renders green by default as requested.
